text: Kim pressed the big red button. Thirty minutes later, the missile came back. It was supposed to scare the whole world. It flew over Japan. Then Alaska. Then it saw the North Pole, panicked, and made a U-turn. Guess which palace it remembered? Boom. Direct hit. Kim survived. Extra crispy. Next morning, Putin called. Not to laugh. He wanted to order ten. Rate Kim's aim from one to ten in the comments.
